properties_with_code.text: A conflicting k-finalization must exhibit two quorums whose intersection weight meets the churn-adjusted slashable lower bound [must-establish 1/1: hconf]
properties_with_code.assertion: implementation must preserve [conflicting_k_finalization τ stake vset parent genesis st]; if so, slashable_bound guarantees [∃ qL qR, max (weight stake vL - act - ext) (weight stake vR - act - ext) ≤ weight stake (qL ∩ qR)]

properties_with_code.text: Two two-thirds quorums must intersect in weight at least their combined weight minus the one-third thresholds [must-establish 1/2: hq1]
properties_with_code.assertion: implementation must preserve [quorum_2 τ stake vset qL vL]; if so, quorum_intersection_weight_lower guarantees [weight stake (vset vL ∩ vset vR) - third τ (weight stake (vset vL)) - third τ (weight stake (vset vR)) ≤ weight stake (qL ∩ qR)]

properties_with_code.text: Two two-thirds quorums must intersect in weight at least their combined weight minus the one-third thresholds [must-establish 2/2: hq2]
properties_with_code.assertion: implementation must preserve [quorum_2 τ stake vset qR vR]; if so, quorum_intersection_weight_lower guarantees [weight stake (vset vL ∩ vset vR) - third τ (weight stake (vset vL)) - third τ (weight stake (vset vR)) ≤ weight stake (qL ∩ qR)]

properties_with_code.text: Validator-set intersection weight must be bounded below by a churn-adjusted (activation/exit) expression
properties_with_code.assertion: validator_intersection_lower_bound guarantees [max (weight stake vL - actwt stake v0 vL - extwt stake v0 vR) (weight stake vR - actwt stake v0 vR - extwt stake v0 vL) ≤ weight stake (vL ∩ vR)] with no must-establish preconditions; audit context: max(wt(vL)-actwt(v0,vL)-extwt(v0,vR), wt(vR)-actwt(v0,vR)-extwt(v0,vL)) <= wt(vL inter vR)

properties_with_code.text: Two distinct blocks justified at the same height must force a slashable quorum intersection [must-establish 1/3: hj1]
properties_with_code.assertion: implementation must preserve [justified τ stake vset parent genesis st b1 h]; if so, two_justified_same_height_slashed guarantees [q_intersection_slashed τ stake vset st]

properties_with_code.text: Two distinct blocks justified at the same height must force a slashable quorum intersection [must-establish 2/3: hj2]
properties_with_code.assertion: implementation must preserve [justified τ stake vset parent genesis st b2 h]; if so, two_justified_same_height_slashed guarantees [q_intersection_slashed τ stake vset st]

properties_with_code.text: Two distinct blocks justified at the same height must force a slashable quorum intersection [must-establish 3/3: hne]
properties_with_code.assertion: implementation must preserve [b1 ≠ b2]; if so, two_justified_same_height_slashed guarantees [q_intersection_slashed τ stake vset st]

properties_with_code.text: The decidable double-vote checker must flag exactly the validators that signed two distinct targets at one target epoch (S1)
properties_with_code.assertion: slashed_double_vote_iff_bex guarantees [slashedB st v = true ↔ ∃ a1 ∈ st.votes, ∃ a2 ∈ st.votes, double_vote v a1 a2] with no must-establish preconditions; audit context: slashedB_S1(st,v) <-> exists two attestations by v with same target_epoch and distinct target_root

properties_with_code.text: The decidable surround-vote checker must flag exactly the validators with a surrounding source-target attestation pair (S2)
properties_with_code.assertion: slashed_surround_vote_iff_bex guarantees [slashedB st v = true ↔ ∃ a1 ∈ st.votes, ∃ a2 ∈ st.votes, surround_vote v a1 a2] with no must-establish preconditions; audit context: slashedB_S2(st,v) <-> exists a1,a2 by v with source(a1)<source(a2) and target(a2)<target(a1)
